note: Family and labour law are the entities' own. Majority: the Family Law of the Federation of BiH (Porodični zakon FBiH, Sl. novine FBiH 35/2005 as amended), article 157: capacity by majority or by marriage before it; a person of 18 is of age. The Republika Srpska's Family Law (Sl. glasnik RS 17/2023), article 94(3), gives full capacity on reaching majority or a court-allowed marriage; its age wasn't found in the text read, and no entity is known to set another, so no regions are held (Brčko District's law wasn't read). Work: the FBiH Labour Law (Zakon o radu, Sl. novine FBiH 26/2016), article 20: no employment contract, and no work of any kind, with a person under fifteen; 15 to 18 with the legal representative's consent and a health finding. The RS Labour Law (Sl. glasnik RS 1/2016 as amended to 59/2026), article 26: employment from at least fifteen; article 27: under 18 only with written parental consent and a health finding. Neither makes an exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below fifteen (my reading). Service: conscription in BiH ended with the state Defence Law of 2005, but no law or Ministry of Defence page saying so was read (mod.gov.ba returned a page with no text); left null. Texts read from Paragraf.ba's free consolidated texts (a private legal publisher). Read again 2026-11-03: the RS Labour Law's articles 26 and 27 say the same in the text as adopted (Sl. glasnik RS 1/16), from the National Assembly of Republika Srpska's own file (later amendments listed there weren't read); the Federation's laws still rest on Paragraf, the Federation government's site having answered with a bot check.

sources.title: Закон о раду (Republika Srpska), Службени гласник 1/16, adopted 29.12.2015; National Assembly of Republika Srpska, adopted-laws page akti/usvojeni-zakoni/zakon-o-radu (Zakon_o_radu.doc in the zip; text as adopted)
sources.said: Члан 26. Радни однос може да се заснује са лицем које има најмање 15 година, одговарајућу здравствену способност ... Члан 27. (1) Радни однос са лицем млађим од 18 година може да се заснује само уз писмену сагласност родитеља, усвојиоца или стараоца, ако такав рад не угрожава његово здравље, морал и образовање ... (2) Лице млађе од 18 година живота може да заснује радни однос само на основу налаза надлежне здравствене установе
